title: LCNB Corp. Announces New Stock Repurchase Program
summary: LEBANON, Ohio, November 23, 2026--LCNB Corp. ("LCNB") (NASDAQ: LCNB) the holding company for LCNB National Bank, today announced that its Board of Directors has authorized a new stock repurchase program under which the Company may repurchase up to 500,000 shares of its outstanding common stock through December 31, 2027.

(Nasdaq: LCNB) today announced that the Company’s Board of Directors declared a cash dividend of $0.23 per common share which is a 4.5% increase over the same period last year.
